dataTeam.title: Data teams are drowning in dashboards nobody reads
dataTeam.mainText: You spend hours building complex dashboards, only for stakeholders to ask the same ad-hoc questions on Slack. The backlog grows, insights are delayed, and valuable data engineers are stuck doing repetitive reporting tasks instead of strategic work.

cards.title: Everything you need to move faster
cards.subTitle: A complete toolkit for the modern data-driven enterprise.

language.title: Natural Language Queries
language.description: Ask complex business questions in plain English and get instant, accurate charts and insights.
language.p3: Charts you can share in one click
language.more: Lumen understands your schema, metrics and business vocabulary. Ask in plain language, refine with follow-ups, and get a chart together with the query it ran behind the scenes.
language.example: Which region grew fastest last quarter, and why?

reports.title: Auto-Generated Reports
reports.description: Schedule comprehensive performance reports that write themselves and deliver straight to Slack.
reports.p3: Always written in your team's tone
reports.more: Describe a report once and Lumen builds it: it pulls the data, writes the narrative, highlights what changed and posts it where your team already works.
reports.example: Every Monday at 9:00 — weekly revenue summary to #leadership

anomaly.title: Anomaly Detection
anomaly.description: AI automatically flags statistically significant deviations in your KPIs before you even ask.
anomaly.p2: Alerts only when it truly matters
anomaly.more: Lumen watches your metrics around the clock, compares them with your seasonal baseline and only pings you when a change is statistically significant.
anomaly.example: Signups dropped 18% in EMEA — likely caused by Tuesday's checkout release.

integrations.title: 50+ Integrations
integrations.description: Connect securely to Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, Salesforce, and all your critical data sources.
integrations.p2: Set up in minutes, no engineers
integrations.more: Native connectors for warehouses, databases, CRMs and BI tools. Authenticate once, pick the tables you want to expose and Lumen maps the schema for you.
integrations.example: Snowflake + Salesforce + Stripe, joined in a single question.

sync.title: Real-Time Sync
sync.description: Your AI agent always has the latest context. No stale data, no delayed insights.
sync.p3: One source of truth for everyone
sync.more: Lumen queries your sources live instead of copying them, so answers always reflect the current state of the business — no nightly jobs, no stale snapshots.
sync.example: Revenue today, as of 2 minutes ago.

security.title: Enterprise Security
security.description: SOC2 compliant, row-level security, and strict data governance policies built-in by default.
security.p3: Full audit log of every question
security.more: Lumen respects the permissions you already have. Every query runs with the asker's access level, is logged for audit, and your data is never used to train models.
security.example: A sales rep only sees the numbers for their own region.

items.a: We employ enterprise-grade encryption (AES-256) at rest and in transit. We are SOC2 Type II compliant and offer strict data localization options. Lumen never trains public models on your proprietary data.
We currently support Snowflake, BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and over 40 other popular data warehouses and SaaS applications.

items.q: Do I need technical skills to use Lumen?
items.a: Not at all. Lumen is designed for business users to ask questions in plain English. Setup takes minutes and requires minimal input from your data engineering team.

items.q: Can it handle complex, custom metrics?
items.a: Yes. During the connection phase, Lumen reads your schema and metadata. You can also manually define complex business logic or unique metrics in our semantic layer.

items.q: How does the Slack integration work?
items.a: You can tag @Lumen in any channel to ask questions, or schedule automated recurring reports to be delivered to specific channels or direct messages at a cadence you choose.
Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial on our Pro plan with no credit card required. You can connect your data and start getting insights immediately.

items.q: Can I export reports and charts?
items.a: Yes. Export any chart as PNG or SVG and any report as PDF or CSV, or share a live link that stays in sync with your data.

items.q: Do you offer role-based access control?
items.a: Yes. Define who can see which tables, columns and metrics. Permissions follow your warehouse roles and SSO groups.
Every answer shows the SQL and the source tables behind it, so you can verify it in one click. You can also certify trusted metrics so Lumen always uses your official definition.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my plan at any time?
items.a: Yes. Upgrade, downgrade or cancel from your billing settings whenever you like. Yearly plans are refunded pro rata within the first 30 days.
Yes. A REST API and SDKs let you ask questions, fetch results and trigger reports from your own apps and internal tools.
